 (  string prop_name , bit [1023:0] prop_val , ref string prop_val_string , input svt_pattern_data :: type_enum typ  ) 

Simple utility used to convert 'bit [1023:0]' property value representation into its equivalent string property value representation. Extended to support decoding of enum values.

prop_name - The name of the property being encoded.

prop_val_string - The string describing the value to be encoded.

prop_val - The bit vector encoding of prop_val_string.

typ - Optional field type used to help in the encode effort.

Return values - The enum value corresponding to the desc.

 rand bit [7:1]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::drop_lpdt_bit = 7'b1111_111

Bit vector value is only considered when error kind is DROP_BITS_IN_ESC_LPDT_BYTE_ERROR. Respective bit element value will indicate whether that bit will be dropped in respective LPDT byte transmission or not.
  • drop_lpdt_bit[1] == 1 : Bit 1 of respective LPDT byte will be dropped.
  • drop_lpdt_bit[1] == 0 : Bit 1 of respective LPDT byte will not be dropped.
  • Same way other bits value of drop_lpdt_bit will be consider to drop or not drop the respective bits in LPDT byte.
  • Note: LPDT byte Bit 0 is excluded from dropping, because internal model has dependency on this.
  • Default is 7'b1111_111.

 rand bit [2:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::invalid_entry_state_error_values[]

Random/User specific HS/ESC entry state error values, considered only when error_kind is INVALID_VALUE_IN_HS_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR. or INVALID_VALUE_IN_ESC_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR. User need to populate the array with valid/invalid HS/ESC entry states values.

  • If user wishes to insert erroneous value LP-101, after Escape Go state, this array should contain values {3'b100, 3'b000, 3'b001, 3'b000, 3'b101}.
  • If user wishes to insert multiple erroneous value LP-101, LP-010, LP-110 etc. after LP-YIELD state, this array should contain values {3'b100, 3'b000, 3'b101, 3'b010, 3'b110}
  • If user wishes to insert erroneous value LP-010 followed by LP-111 after HS-Request state, this array should contain values {3'b001, 3'b010, 3'b111}
  • Note: User should specify LP-111 as last element of this array, because after sending all these array element values model will transmit the correct HS/ESC entry values. On reception of LP-111, the receiver resets itself and wait for fresh request.

 rand bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::lane_error_enable = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'hF

Specifies lane error enable value. Respective bit value [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES(4) - 1):0] indicates which lane error injection is enabled.
  • lane_error_enable [0] = 1 : Indicates Lane zero error injection is enabled.
  • lane_error_enable [0] = 0 : Indicates Lane zero error injection is not enabled.
  • Note: Same definition should be considered for lane_error_enable[(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES(4) - 1):1] values. Also lane_error_enable value should be non-zero.
  • Default value is 4'hF, all lane error injection is enabled.

 rand bit [15:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pattern_error_value = 16'h0000

Specifies 16bit invalid value in case of INVALID_PREAMBLE_ALT_SEQ_CAL_ID, INVALID_PREAMBLE_ALT_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN, INVALID_PREAMBLE_USER_SEQ_CAL_ID or INVALID_PREAMBLE_USER_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN.

 rand int unsigned  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::post_error_range_max = 1

Specifies the maximum range value up to which the Post symbols are corrupted. Post pattern range from 7 symbols to 224 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_post_length[4:0] value. post_error_range_max value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 223rd symbol and it should be greater or equal to post_error_range_min. Default value is 1.

 rand int unsigned  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::post_error_range_min = 0

Specifies the minimum range value from where the Post symbols are corrupted. Post pattern range from 7 symbols to 224 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_post_length[4:0] value. post_error_range_min value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 223rd symbol and it should be smaller or equal to post_error_range_max. Default value is 0.

 rand bit [1:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::post_error_value = 0

Specifies the Post symbol error value.
  • error_kind == RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between post_error_range_min and post_error_range_max range, random corrupted value will be transmitted.
  • error_kind == USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between post_error_range_min and post_error_range_max range, post_error_value value will be transmitted.
  • This error will be injected only when t3_post_error_value size == 0.
  • Default value is 0.

 rand bit  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::ppi_error_insertion_for_complete_transaction = 0

Specifies whether to keep PPI error insertion for complete transaction or not.
  • 1 : Keep PPI error insertion for complete transaction starting from 'ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_min/max' value
  • 0 : PPI error insertion duration will be inbetween 'ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_min/max' and 'ppi_error_insertion_end_num_of_clks_range_min/max' value. Not for complete transaction.
  • Default value is 0.

 rand int unsigned  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_begin_error_range_max = 1

Specifies the maximum range value up to which the Pre-begin symbols are corrupted. Pre-begin pattern range from 7 symbols to 448 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_preamble_length[5:0] value. pre_begin_error_range_max value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 447th symbol and it should be greater or equal to pre_begin_error_range_min. Default value is 1.

 rand int unsigned  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_begin_error_range_min = 0

Specifies the minimum range value from where the Pre-begin symbols are corrupted. Pre-begin pattern range from 7 symbols to 448 symbols based on configuration attribute tgr_preamble_length[5:0] value. pre_begin_error_range_min value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 447th symbol and it should be smaller or equal to pre_begin_error_range_max. Default value is 0.

 rand bit [2:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_begin_error_value = 0

Specifies the Pre-begin symbol error value.
  • error_kind == RAND_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between pre_begin_error_range_min and pre_begin_error_range_max range, random corrupted(excluding 3) value will be transmitted.
  • error_kind == USER_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between pre_begin_error_range_min and pre_begin_error_range_max range, pre_begin_error_value value will be transmitted.
  • Default value is 0.

 rand bit [6:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_end_error_mask_value = 1

Specifies mask for Pre-end 7 symbol value. Respective bit value [6:0] indicates which Pre-end symbol will be corrupted.
  • pre_end_error_mask_value[0] = 1 : Indicates Pre-end symbol zero will be corrupted by pre_end_error_value[0].
  • pre_end_error_mask_value[0] = 0 : Indicates Pre-end symbol zero will not be corrupted by pre_end_error_value[0].
  • Note: Same definition should be consider for pre_end_error_mask_value[7:1] values.
  • Default value is 1.

 rand bit [2:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::pre_end_error_value[6:0] = { 1 , 1 , 4 , 2 , 1 , 2 , 2 }

Random/User specific Pre-end error value, considered only when error_kind 'PRE_END_SOT_HS_ERROR'. Based on pre_end_error_mask_value & pre_end_error_value, Pre-end will be transmitted. Default value is {1,1,4,2,1,2,2}.

 rand bit [3:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::prog_seq_error_range_max = 1

Specifies the maximum range value up to which the Prog-seq symbols are corrupted. Prog-seq pattern duration is 14 symbols. prog_seq_error_range_max value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 13th symbol and it should be greater or equal to prog_seq_error_range_min. Default value is 1.

 rand bit [3:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::prog_seq_error_range_min = 0

Specifies the minimum range value from where the Prog-seq symbols are corrupted. Prog-seq pattern duration is 14 symbols. prog_seq_error_range_min value can be configured/generated between 0th symbol to 13th symbol and it should be smaller or equal to prog_seq_error_range_max. Default value is 0.

 rand bit [2:0]   attribute

  • error_kind == RAND_PROG_SEQ_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between prog_seq_error_range_min and prog_seq_error_range_max range, random corrupted value will be transmitted.
  • error_kind == USER_PROG_SEQ_SOT_HS_ERROR : For each corrupted symbol between prog_seq_error_range_min and prog_seq_error_range_max range, prog_seq_error_value value will be transmitted.
  • Default value is 0.

 rand bit [20:0]   attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::t3_post_error_value[]

Specifies the errorneous value to be driven during T3-Post length when error kind is USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR or RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR The values specified in the array will be transmitted in place of T3-Post symbols 21 bits represents 7 symbols in t3-post. MSB [20:18] - will be transmitted first and LSB [2:0] - will be transmissted last Value greater than or equal to 4 in each symbol will be sent as 4.

 typedef enum  svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::error_kind_enum
Indicates invalid line value insertion in ESC mode entry sequence. After the transmission of invalid line value in ESC entry mode, valid ESC sequence will be transmitted implicitly.
NONE_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_NONE_ERROR )
Indicates No error.
USER_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_USER_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates User specific PRE-BEGIN error in SOT phase.
RAND_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_RAND_PRE_BEGIN_SOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates Random PRE-BEGIN error in SOT phase.
USER_PROG_SEQ_SOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_USER_PROG_SEQ_SOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates User specific PROG-SEQ error in SOT phase.
RAND_PROG_SEQ_SOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_RAND_PROG_SEQ_SOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates Random PROG-SEQ error in SOT phase.
PRE_END_SOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_PRE_END_SOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates PRE-END error in SOT phase.
INVERT_SYNC_WORD_SOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVERT_SYNC_WORD_SOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates inverted SYNC-WORD error in SOT phase.
RAND_SYNC_WORD_SOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_RAND_SYNC_WORD_SOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates random SYNC-WORD value error in SOT phase.
INVERT_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVERT_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR )
Indicates lane transaction payload_data [15:0] will be inverted in DATA phase.
RAND_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_RAND_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR )
Indicates lane transaction payload_data [15:0] will have random value error in DATA phase.
DROP_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_DROP_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR )
Indicates lane transaction payload_data [15:0] will be dropped in DATA phase.
INSERT_SYNC_WORD_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INSERT_SYNC_WORD_DATA_VALUE_HS_ERROR )
Indicates SYNC-WORD will be inserted in DATA phase.
USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates User specific POST error in EOT phase.
RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR )
Indicates Random POST error in EOT phase.
INVERT_SYNC_WORD_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVERT_SYNC_WORD_HS_ERROR )
Indicates inverted SYNC-WORD error in High Speed Transmission(Sync Word corruption coming in identical Packet Header Data with CSI2).
RAND_SYNC_WORD_HS_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_RAND_SYNC_WORD_HS_ERROR )
Indicates random SYNC-WORD value error in High Speed Transmission(Sync Word corruption coming in identical Packet Header Data with CSI2).
INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_REQUEST_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_REQUEST_ERROR )
Indicates invalid value(excluding 3'b001 & 3'b000) insertion after HS-REQUEST.
INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_PREPARE_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_PREPARE_ERROR )

INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_RQST_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_RQST_ERROR )

INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_YIELD_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_YIELD_ERROR )
Indicates invalid value(excluding 3'b000 & 3'b001) insertion after LP-YIELD.
INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_RQST_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_RQST_ERROR )

INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_GO_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_GO_ERROR )

INVALID_ESC_GO_DURATION_ERROR( `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_INVALID_ESC_GO_DURATION_ERROR )

  constraint
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::valid_ranges

Valid ranges constraints insure that the error_kind types and error values are supported by the mipi_cphy components.
constraint valid_ranges {
    pre_begin_error_range_min inside {[0: (((cfg.tgr_preamble_length[5:0] + 1) * 7)-1)]};
    pre_begin_error_range_max inside {[0: (((cfg.tgr_preamble_length[5:0] + 1) * 7)-1)]};
    (pre_begin_error_range_min <= pre_begin_error_range_max);
    (pre_begin_error_value != 3);
     ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_min inside {[1: 10]};
    ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_max inside {[1: 10]};
    (ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_min <= ppi_error_insertion_start_num_of_clks_range_max);
     ppi_error_insertion_end_num_of_clks_range_min inside {[1: 10]};
    ppi_error_insertion_end_num_of_clks_range_max inside {[1: 10]};
    (ppi_error_insertion_end_num_of_clks_range_min <= ppi_error_insertion_end_num_of_clks_range_max);
     prog_seq_error_range_min inside {[0:13]};
    prog_seq_error_range_max inside {[0:13]};
    (prog_seq_error_range_min <= prog_seq_error_range_max);
      pre_end_error_mask_value != 0;
      foreach(pre_end_error_value[i]) {
      pre_end_error_value[i] dist {[0:2]:=10, 3:=1,[4:7]:=2};
    }
        (data_error_value != (xact.data_payload));
     post_error_range_min inside {[0: (((cfg.tgr_post_length[4:0] + 1) * 7)-1)]};
    post_error_range_max inside {[0: (((cfg.tgr_post_length[4:0] + 1) * 7)-1)]};
    (post_error_range_min <= post_error_range_max);
        foreach(sync_word_error_value[i]) {
      sync_word_error_value[i] dist {[0:2]:=10, 3:=1,4:=1,[5:7]:=2};
    }
    if(cfg.cphy_protocol_version >= svt_mipi_cphy_configuration::CPHY_VERSION_12) {
      !(sync_word_error_value[0] inside {0,1,2,3,4});
    }
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_REQUEST_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b001 && invalid_error_value != 3'b000);
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_PREPARE_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b000);
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_RQST_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b100 && invalid_error_value != 3'b000);
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_YIELD_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b000 && invalid_error_value != 3'b001);
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_RQST_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b001 && invalid_error_value != 3'b000);
     ((error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_GO_ERROR) || (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_CMD_ERROR)) -> (invalid_error_value == 3'b111);
     (error_kind == INVALID_ESC_GO_DURATION_ERROR) -> (invalid_esc_go_duration > cfg.esc_mode_silence_to_counter);
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_IN_MARK_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b100);
     (error_kind == DROP_BITS_IN_ESC_LPDT_BYTE_ERROR) -> (drop_lpdt_bit != 7'b0000_000);
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_POST_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b111);
     (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_MARK_ERROR) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b100 && invalid_error_value != 3'b111);
     (error_kind == INVALID_PREAMBLE_CAL_VALUE) -> (invalid_error_value != 3'b001);
     (error_kind == INVALID_PREAMBLE_CAL_VALUE) -> (preamble_error_in_symbols < cfg.t_3_calpreamble);
     (error_kind == INVALID_PREAMBLE_ALT_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN) -> (preamble_error_in_symbols < cfg.t_3_calaltseq);
     (error_kind == INVALID_PREAMBLE_USER_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN) -> (preamble_error_in_symbols < cfg.t_3_caludefseq);
     (error_kind == INVALID_PREAMBLE_CAL_VALUE) -> (repeat_cal_error < cfg.t_3_calpreamble);
     (error_kind == INVALID_PREAMBLE_ALT_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN) -> (repeat_cal_error < cfg.t_3_calaltseq);
     (error_kind == INVALID_PREAMBLE_USER_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN) -> (repeat_cal_error < cfg.t_3_caludefseq);
         if(cfg.calibration_type == svt_mipi_cphy_types::PREAMBLE_USER_SEQ_CAL) {
      cal_id_error_value[6] != 3'b011; cal_id_error_value[5] != 3'b011; cal_id_error_value[4] != 3'b011; cal_id_error_value[3] != 3'b011; cal_id_error_value[2] != 3'b01;cal_id_error_value[1] != 3'b001; cal_id_error_value[0] != 3'b011;
    }
    if(cfg.calibration_type == svt_mipi_cphy_types::PREAMBLE_ALT_SEQ_CAL) {
      foreach(cal_id_error_value[i])
        cal_id_error_value[i] != 3'b011;
    }
     (ppi_error_kind == PPI_NON_ZERO_TX_DATA_HS_31_16_WHEN_TX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_16_BIT_SELECTED_ERROR || ppi_error_kind == PPI_NON_ZERO_RX_DATA_HS_31_16_WHEN_RX_DATA_WIDTH_HS_16_BIT_SELECTED_ERROR) -> (data_hs_31_16_bit_error_value != 16'h00);
     (ppi_error_kind == PPI_ASSERT_TX_REQUEST_ESC_WITH_TX_LPDT_ESC_AND_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_ERROR || ppi_error_kind == PPI_ASSERT_TX_REQUEST_ESC_WITH_TX_ULPS_ESC_AND_TX_TRIGGER_ESC_ERROR || ppi_error_kind == PPI_ASSERT_RX_ACTIVE_HS_AND_RX_TRIGGER_ESC_SIMULTANEOUSLY_ERROR) -> (trigger_esc_error_value != 4'b0);
     !(cmd_error_value inside { 8'b11100001, 8'b00011110, 8'b01100010, 8'b01011101, 8'b00100001, 8'b10100000});
     lane_error_enable != 0;
     if((error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_IN_HS_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR) || (error_kind == INVALID_VALUE_IN_ESC_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR)){
      num_invalid_entry_state_error_values inside {[1 : 10]};
    } else {
      num_invalid_entry_state_error_values == 0;
    }
    invalid_entry_state_error_values.size() == num_invalid_entry_state_error_values;
     if((error_kind == USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR ) || (error_kind == RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR)){
      num_t3_post_error_value inside {[1 : (cfg.tgr_post_length + 1)]};
    } else {
      num_t3_post_error_value == 0;
    }
    t3_post_error_value.size() == num_t3_post_error_value;
  }
